reason: I would not move money this week on a first look. My Indian bank can still call me or ask me to come in no matter who files the forms, and I have not seen the actual exchange rate, so I cannot compare it to the paisa.
objection: My Indian bank will still call me or ask me to come in, so I do not see what this really saves me. I also cannot judge the real cost until I see the rate, since the fee is only part of it.
would_change_my_mind: A clear written statement of what my bank will and will not still require from me, plus a sample rate quote I can compare against my bank and Wise before I commit.
